verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a REST API and a bot framework built on it, which is the basis for building integrations, but the evidence pack shows no explicit official language SDKs (e.g., Python/JS client libraries) beyond the API reference page and bot docs, and probes for llms.txt/OpenAPI spec all 404. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages/repos, multi-language client library docs, OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and any hands-on developer confirmation of SDK usability.
